name: text-like-predicates
description: text prefix, substring and negated LIKE filtering

queries.name: prefix-books
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE category LIKE 'bo%'

queries.name: contains-o
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE category LIKE '%o%'

queries.name: exclude-g
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE category NOT LIKE 'g%'
